description: Header file defining the SSLClientSessionCache class for managing SSL session caching, including configuration, key management, and cache operations.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache
classes.description: Manages SSL session cache with configurable size, expiration, and session operations.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the session cache, including max entries and expiration check count.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Key
classes.description: Unique key for cache entries, including server info, IP address, privacy mode, and crypto settings.

classes.name: SSLClientSessionCache::Entry
classes.description: Internal structure holding up to two SSL sessions for cache management.

methods.name: SSLClientSessionCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with specified configuration.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Static method to determine if an SSL session has expired based on current time.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a session for a given cache key, moving it to MRU position.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a session into the cache under a specific key.

methods.name: ClearEarlyData
methods.description: Clears early data support for sessions associated with a cache key.

methods.name: FlushForServer
methods.description: Removes all cache entries for a specific server.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing purposes.
